main.description: A proposed new name for a segment (segments/segment-names) or a dive site (dive-sites/site-names); the collection keeps its segment name so the interactions space declaration needn't change. Public: stored only in the proposer's repo, never in a space, and names its proposer. The AppView accepts it only from an athlete with efforts on the segment (visits to the site) on enough distinct dates, while it is active and outside the cooldown after an adoption, and only one open proposal per athlete per segment or site. Rewriting an open proposal with a different name clears its votes; a rewrite of a closed one is ignored.

segment.description: The app.activitytracker.feed.segment or app.activitytracker.feed.diveSite the name is for, told apart by its collection.
